sources.quote: Lambda Draconis, also named Giausar, is a solitary, orange-red star in the northern circumpolar constellation of Draco.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 811 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,785 K, so 66.319 solar radii.
